title: Refresh Autoset
description: It changes the default settings of Vanilla Refresh datapack
body:
It just changes the default settings of Vanilla Refresh datapack to ones i need in my modpack. I personally found the default settings inconvenient for my usage.

I figured out later how to change default settings via it's [ intended way](https://github.com/limesplatus/Vanilla-Refresh/wiki/Changing-Default-Settings). But hey, this is work i already did in MCreator. Why should i do it again.

The official Vanilla Refresh datapack/mod is available on Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/datapack/vanilla-refresh

specifically, it:\
disables water splashes\
disables displaying mob health\
disables the particle effects around some blocks (just the ones added by the Vanilla Refresh datapack, not the vanilla ones)\
disables the "Drop Ladder" function\
disables stats above players\
disables XP orbs from teleporting to you\
enables disc looping in a jukebox\

if it doesn't change the settings automatically, you can run /function vanila_refresh_autoset:autoset
